card.name: Before-travel timing in malaria prophylaxis
card.fires_on: The word 'before' or 'prior to' after a time span (e.g. '2 weeks before'), where the next word is expected to be 'travel' or 'departure', mainly in malaria prophylaxis instructions. It also fires weakly on word pieces inside travel-site names.

modes.label: Start before travel
modes.description: 'before' or 'prior to' after a time span in prophylaxis start instructions, where 'travel' comes next.
modes.example: Prophylaxis Treatment must start 2 weeks<< before>> travel to an endemic area.

modes.label: Travel site names
modes.description: Weak firing on pieces of travel-related names or links, such as Wikitravel or a travelers URL.
